# Greenpeace UK

> > Greenpeace UK campaigns for environmental protection through direct action, research, and advocacy on climate change, ocean conservation, forest protection, and environmental justice.

Greenpeace UK is the British branch of the international environmental organization, founded in Vancouver, dedicated to protecting the planet through campaigns, investigations, and direct action. The site provides guides to major environmental challenges, news on ongoing campaigns, and opportunities for supporters to take action through volunteering, donations, and activism.

## Key Topics

- Climate change
- Ocean conservation
- Fossil fuels
- Direct action
- Environmental activism
- Deforestation
- Plastic pollution
- Biodiversity
- Environmental justice
- Renewable energy
- Indigenous rights
- Non-violent protest
- Global Ocean Treaty
- North Sea
- Amazon rainforest

## About Greenpeace

- [Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk): Greenpeace UK homepage with campaigns on climate, oceans, and fossil fuels
- [About Greenpeace - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/about-greenpeace): Organization mission and history from Vancouver founding to present
- [Greenpeace victories - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/about-greenpeace/victories): Greenpeace's environmental achievements including Global Ocean Treaty wins
- [How Greenpeace creates change - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/about-greenpeace/how-we-create-change): Organizational strategy: lobbying, investigations, direct action methods

## Environmental Challenges & Issues

- [Explore the issues - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/challenges): Overview of major environmental issues: climate, pollution, biodiversity
- [Climate change - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/challenges/climate-change): Climate change guide: extreme weather, sea level rise, greenhouse gases
- [How we can protect the oceans - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/challenges/ocean-protection): Ocean protection guide: sanctuaries, overfishing, deep-sea mining
- [Forests - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/challenges/forests): Forest conservation guide: Amazon, deforestation, biodiversity protection
- [Plastic pollution - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/challenges/plastic-pollution): Plastic pollution guide: ocean impact, waste, recycling solutions
- [Wildlife and biodiversity - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/challenges/wildlife-and-biodiversity): Wildlife guide: endangered species, habitat protection, ecosystem conservation
- [Environmental justice - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/challenges/environmental-justice): Environmental justice guide: racism, indigenous rights, just transition

## Get Involved & Take Action

- [Take action - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/take-action): Action hub: campaigns, petitions, volunteering, donations for supporters
- [Support Greenpeace - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/support-us): Donation page: one-off and monthly contributions to fund campaigns
- [Support Us | Greenpeace UK](https://donate.greenpeace.org.uk/website-monthly): Monthly donation signup page with direct debit and membership options
- [Volunteering and activism - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/volunteering): Volunteering opportunities: local teams, activism, direct action training
- [Become a trained Greenpeace activist - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/volunteering/direct-action): Activist training guide: non-violent protest, direct action techniques

## News & Research

- [Latest updates - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/latest-updates): News hub: latest stories, explainers, press releases on campaigns
- [Research and analysis - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/in-depth): In-depth reports: climate energy, plastics, policy briefings, corporate accountability
- [Open letter: Starmer must pick a side](https://action.greenpeace.org.uk/trump-open-letter): Political petition to Keir Starmer on fossil fuels and protest rights

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Greenpeace - Greenpeace UK](https://www.greenpeace.org.uk/contact): Contact info, London office, press centre, donation management
